name: Shimotsuki Eriko
source:
She is the aunt of the main character's cousin. She is calm and natural. She is very honest and gullible, and her house is filled with mysterious vases and other things. 

She signed up for a self-help seminar to change herself, but apparently, she signed up for the wrong one. 

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/tougenkyo/taiken/chara.html]official site[/url]]
